report:
Baseline: independently compared both current whole-file fragments (check/expr.rs and semantic_spec.rs) with the historical input: exact equality. The captured historical rationale is a substantive TODO assessment, not behavioral test execution; its conclusion was reassessed against the complete current claim and association metadata.
Fresh source assessment: the ordinary expr.rs association checks each binary operand independently and delegates to check_binary_operator without equating their types or imposing a domain from the token. Captured operator.rs provides additional context: all sixteen overloadable tokens map to trait methods; And/Or take the boolean control-flow path. The method signature is instantiated with separate left/right owner arguments, retaining the trait and associated Output relation (or bool result), and creates a provisional ResolvedCall with StaticTrait dispatch plus proof obligations. Missing metadata, unsupported signatures and invalid argument shapes produce error nodes. There is no primitive arithmetic lowering in this helper. This supports the implemented construction slice, not an assertion that every deferred proof/completion case already works. The captured architectural decision places primitive specialization after Typed IR and after concrete substitution; it is a future codegen boundary, not implemented codegen coverage.
Complete associated test set: sole test sage_meta::todo::checking_body_operator_calls has no assertions. It explicitly defers the mapping/heterogeneous-shift matrix, ordinary core metadata proof traces, positive and negative source/rustc-oracle cases, concrete primitive/generic/user-defined and nonnumeric-shift operations, distinct Rhs and Output, preservation of Any before proof selection, lazy booleans and rejection of 1 + true. It cannot detect a regression such as accepting an unsupported operand pair or publishing an ambiguous provisional call. These remain verification gaps, not passing behavioral evidence. The TODO implementation entry explicitly identifies incomplete generic operator bodies and unknown-Self candidate hints. Those capabilities and the documented proof-trace/source-oracle matrix are prerequisites to claiming universal primitive/generic completion, ambiguity/unsupported rejection, and inference preservation. The token mapping assertions present in the captured helper provide limited supplementary source evidence only, not an additional associated test.
Disposition: retain the existing explicit implementation and verification TODOs. Every claim aspect is accounted for by the visible construction slice or the declared deferred matrix; no claim of complete implementation or adequate executed behavioral coverage is made. No edits requested for this unchanged deferred accounting.
Execution: ran review start/read and exact-source comparison, and recorded this report. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported suite/build results are separate evidence and were not used as a substitute for source assessment.
